runs.text: How does OAuth login with Google work?

beats.say: The user clicks “Login with Google”, and the app starts the OAuth flow.
The app redirects the user’s browser to Google’s authentication page.
Google asks the user to consent, then redirects back with an authorization code.
The app sends that code to Google’s token endpoint to trade it for a token.
Google returns an access token (and optionally a refresh token) to the app.
The app calls Google’s API with the token to fetch the user’s profile.
